title: Bjørn's Salt Run
offer: My boat leaks, and the fishers of Ekvik wait for salt! Take eight sacks for me from here to Ekvik. Your new hold is just right.

steps.load_say: Eight sacks of the best salt from the sea. Keep them dry!
steps.say: Bjørn's salt, brought by you? Then I pay you, not him. Ha!

fact: Salt was boiled out of sea water in big pans, and traded far inland.
